major_cooldowns.name: Adrenaline Rush
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast on cooldown at 2 or fewer combo points and keep it as close to 100% uptime as possible since Restless Blades reduces its cooldown; pre-pot and align with Bloodlust for the strongest window.

major_cooldowns.name: Roll the Bones
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast on cooldown whenever Roll the Bones is at stage 1 or lower, rerolling weak results to chase a higher-stage buff; never let the buff drop.

major_cooldowns.name: Keep It Rolling
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use whenever Roll the Bones is at stage 2 or higher to lock in a strong combination; its effective cooldown is far shorter than 6 minutes thanks to Restless Blades, so do not hold it long.

major_cooldowns.name: Blade Rush
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast on cooldown for single target unless it would overcap energy within the next global, and always use it in AoE.

major_cooldowns.name: Killing Spree
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast at 5 or more combo points on the Trickster build, cancelling early if you are about to overcap energy; avoid casting when the animation lock would put you in danger of a mechanic.

major_cooldowns.name: Vanish
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: On Hidden Opportunity builds, use on cooldown when you have no Audacity or Opportunity proc to gain a free empowered Ambush; on other builds reserve it for utility or mechanic immunity.

rules.action: Cast Adrenaline Rush every time it is available at 2 or fewer combo points; maximizing its uptime is the single biggest driver of Outlaw damage because Restless Blades shortens its own cooldown.

rules.description: Maintain Roll the Bones, reroll weak buffs
rules.action: Never let Roll the Bones expire; recast it on cooldown when you are at stage 1 or lower and reroll until you reach a higher stage.

rules.description: Opener: Adrenaline Rush into Roll the Bones
rules.action: Open with Adrenaline Rush, then Roll the Bones and Slice and Dice, fire Keep It Rolling if you land stage 3 or higher, use Blade Rush, build to 6 combo points with Sinister Strike and Pistol Shot, then cast Between the Eyes and resume the normal priority.

rules.description: Hold Keep It Rolling for a strong Roll the Bones
rules.action: Do not press Keep It Rolling until Roll the Bones is at stage 2 or higher so you duplicate a strong buff set rather than a single weak buff.
Cast Between the Eyes at 6 or more combo points and Dispatch as your filler finisher; never sit at max combo points where Sinister Strike or Pistol Shot would overcap and waste resources.

rules.description: React to Opportunity and Audacity procs
rules.action: Spend Opportunity with Pistol Shot when it reaches high stacks or is about to expire, and immediately use Ambush when Audacity is active; weave these procs in without dropping your action-per-second pace.

rules.description: Activate Blade Flurry at 2 or more targets
rules.action: Turn on Blade Flurry as soon as there are 2 or more targets and it is not active, and refresh it at 4 or fewer combo points when 4 or more targets are in range so cleave damage never lapses.

rules.description: Stay in melee range of the target
rules.action: Remain in melee range so your generators and finishers connect every global; Outlaw has no rear-positioning requirement but loses heavy uptime when forced out of range.
